name: colorblind-dark
about: For a dark terminal, measured against #15171a. Built from the Okabe-Ito qualitative families, then solved rather than picked: every one of the six source roles stays at least dE*ab 25 from every other under normal vision AND under simulated protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia. `string`, `number` and `function` are the same colours as `ok`, `warn` and `err` on purpose — one vocabulary, so the status triple inherits the separation proved for the source six instead of being argued for twice.
